title: Riba & Interest: The Complete Islamic Guide
description: Riba (usury) explained in depth from the Qur'an and Sunnah, by Salafi scholars: what riba is (it is more than 'interest'), how it applies in modern banking, mortgages in non-Muslim lands, working for riba-based institutions, and the Islamic alternatives. Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble, Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem, Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan (AMAR) and Islamic Finance Guru.
short_description: Riba explained: the complete Islamic ruling on usury

modules.title: What Is Riba?
modules.description: The definition of riba, why it is forbidden, and what counts as riba today.

lessons.title: What Is Riba — Is It the Same as Interest?
lessons.content: The linguistic and legal definition of riba: when extra payment for time is forbidden and when it is not. source: Sheikh Assim Al Hakeem (assimalhakeem, https://www.youtube.com/@assimalhakeem) — Salafi scholar, English-language fatwa Q&A from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

lessons.title: Riba Is Not Just Interest — An Important Reminder
lessons.content: Why riba is broader than bank interest and applies in every exchange of the six categories (gold, silver, wheat, barley, dates, salt). Ustadh Muhammad Tim Humble.

lessons.title: Islamic Finance: Murābaḥah, Installments & Ribā Clarified
lessons.content: Murābaḥah financing and installment sales explained: the boundary between halal profit and riba. source: AMAR — AMAU's Arabic-language broadcasts (https://www.youtube.com/@AMARofficial); Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan, translated in English

lessons.title: 10 Times Interest Is Not Halal: IFG Clarifies
lessons.content: Ten misconceptions about when interest might be allowed - IFG dissects each one. Islamic Finance Guru.

modules.title: Riba in Modern Life
modules.description: Jobs, banks, mortgages and alternatives, with scholarly rulings.

lessons.title: Working for a Company That Deals with Riba — Permissible or Not?

lessons.title: Is It Okay to Work at a Riba-Based Bank If Not Directly Dealing with Riba?

lessons.title: Scholars Who Say Mortgage Loans Are Permissible in the Land of Disbelievers
